frame.note: signed axes in the original BodyParts3D frame: superior, anterior (nose direction) and the subject's left

geometry: float32 positions in the original BodyParts3D frame; every GLB node transform is identity (no quantization, no re-centring); EXT_meshopt_compression (required) - three.js GLTFLoader needs setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder). No normals/UVs/materials. Element meshes are concatenated, not welded to each other: a merged mesh is a set of separately closed shells.

muscleInventory.note: BodyParts3D 4.0 "muscle of face" (FMA46751) contains only the extra-ocular muscles; no muscles of facial expression or mastication exist in the dataset. Right longus colli is missing (left parts only). The facial-expression and masticatory muscles are provided separately in muscles.glb from BodyParts3D 3.0 (see "muscles").

frameRegistration.method: affine ICP (3x4, least squares, 30 iterations, symmetric nearest-vertex correspondences restricted to the same bone) fitted on BodyParts3D 3.0 vs 4.0 skull bones; applied to every 3.0 muscle vertex
